clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Winter's Presents await beneath the festive tree during the Feast of Winter Veil. Holiday organizers and goblin apparatus tenders direct Horde heroes to Great-father Winter, where gifts have been prepared for them.

The Feast of Winter Veil brings a pause for celebration to Orgrimmar as the chill winds of late year sweep across Durotar. Promoters from Smokywood Pastures and holiday enthusiasts spread word through the capital that gifts wait beneath the decorated tree. Warriors, hunters, and wanderers resting in the city are all invited to share in the season’s generosity.

Great-father Winter sits among holiday ribbons and packaged cartons near the Smokywood Pastures market. The ancient figure marks the season’s renewal, while goblin merchants nearby offer seasonal wares and festive treats to visitors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hear Great-father Winter - with the generous support of Smokeywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Orgrimmar. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.
But you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Great-father Winter has some presents with your name on them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, ho hello there! You can only be here for one reason: to open your Winter Veil presents.
Now, don't you worry, Great-father Winter hasn't forgotten about his favorite traveler adventurer. Look under the tree and you'll find your gifts.
During this season of giving, perhaps your friends would also enjoy receiving some of Smokeywood Pasture's excellent products?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
